test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper( Held On: 16 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Four abbreviations have been given, out of which three are alike in some manner and one is different. Select the odd one.
solution:
The logic followed here is:

 
• **NTPC, SAIL and BHEL are Maharatna PSUs of Government of India whereas CRPF is not a Maharatna PSU.**

 
• CRPF : Central Reserve Police Force
 
• NTPC: National Thermal Power Corporation
 
• SAIL : Steel Authority of India Limited.
 
• BHEL : Bharat Heavy Electricals Limited.

Hence, CRPF is the odd one.
